comment: The toolchains that no other file of the checkout declares (T19.2). php lists the PHP minor version that the suite runs on, the pin of kit: setup-php installs the latest patch of a minor and cannot pin a patch, so the minor is the pin and each CI run records the patch it ran on in its report. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform; mise.toml declares the tools it installs (Go, Python with uv, ruff, vulture, alint, golangci-lint, deadcode, govulncheck, cargo-audit and Composer) and mise.lock locks them for every platform of the bootstrap (T24.12). symbolExtractors names the PHP symbol programs of kit that lint-php and the PHP extension build read.

phpExtension.reason: the PHP minors for which the release builds the PHP extension on each native platform: an extension loads only into the PHP minor whose headers built it. The php job of .github/workflows/assets.yml declares each platform and minor once, sets up matrix.php, and runs make release-php-ext PHP=php with EXPECTED_PHP_MINOR from that row; tests/scripts/php-version.test.mts and assets-php-matrix.test.mts verify the scoped setup and ownership

llvm.reason: the major release of the LLVM whose libclang and clang the bindgen of ext-php-rs uses in make release-php-ext of packages/release.mk (binding GN-19d, GN-19h): clang-sys takes the libclang of the highest LLVM that it finds and bindgen asks the clang of PATH for its headers, so the two differ on a machine with several LLVM releases, and the ubuntu-26.04 runners hold LLVM 20, 21 and 22 with clang 21 as /usr/bin/clang. make install-llvm installs it; the recipe reads LLVM_ROOT, /usr/lib/llvm-<major> on Linux and the Homebrew formula llvm@<major> on macOS
llvm.removal: when the build of the PHP extension no longer runs bindgen, or a release of ext-php-rs no longer reads the libclang of the machine
